title: Locally constant cover and filtration
statement: Let ℓ be a prime number and let F_ℓ = ℤ/ℓℤ, the field with ℓ elements. In Lean the coefficient field is its universe lift ULift (ZMod ℓ), which has the same field operations. Let U be an irreducible scheme, let G be a finite locally constant sheaf of F_ℓ-vector spaces on U. Then there exist a scheme V, a connected finite étale morphism v : V ⟶ U, and d : ℕ such that ℓ does not divide d, every geometric fibre of v has cardinality d, and v^*G has a finite filtration starting at zero and ending at v^*G whose successive cokernels are isomorphic to the constant sheaf F_ℓ on V. Conventions: irreducibility [def-weil-irreducible-components], connectedness [def-weil-connected-scheme], small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], coefficient-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], finite étale morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], pullback [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point]. Geometric-fibre cardinality counts lifts [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre]; for finite étale morphisms over a separably closed field these correspond to the points of the fibre scheme.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For irreducible $U$ and finite locally constant $G$ of
$\mathbf F_\ell$-vector spaces, there is a finite etale
$v:V\to U$ of degree prime to $\ell$ such that $v^{-1}G$ has a filtration by
constant $\mathbf F_\ell$-sheaves, and $G$ is a direct summand of
$v_*v^{-1}G$.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
Choose a geometric point $\bar u$ of $U$. The locally constant sheaf gives
a representation

$$
\rho:\pi_1(U,\bar u)\longrightarrow
\operatorname{GL}_{\mathbf F_\ell}(G_{\bar u})
$$

with finite image $Q$. If $H\subseteq Q$ is an $\ell$-Sylow subgroup, the
inverse image $\rho^{-1}(H)$ defines a connected finite etale cover
$v:V\to U$ of degree $d=[Q:H]$, which is prime to $\ell$. On $V$, the
monodromy factors through $H$.

The representation filtration gives
$0=V_0\subset V_1\subset\cdots\subset V_m=G_{\bar u}$ with
$V_a/V_{a-1}\cong\mathbf F_\ell$ and trivial $H$-action. Passing from
$H$-modules to locally constant sheaves gives, for every $a$, the explicit
short exact sequence

$$
0\longrightarrow G_{a-1}\longrightarrow G_a\longrightarrow
\underline{\mathbf F_\ell}_V\longrightarrow0,
\qquad G_m=v^{-1}G.
$$

All inclusions, quotient maps, and connecting maps commute with extension of
the algebraically closed ground field.

The adjunction unit and the fibrewise sum are

$$
\eta:G\longrightarrow v_*v^{-1}G,\qquad
\operatorname{tr}:v_*v^{-1}G\longrightarrow G.
$$

At a geometric stalk, $\eta(s)=(s,\ldots,s)$ in the direct sum indexed by
the $d$ points of the fibre, while
$\operatorname{tr}(s_1,\ldots,s_d)=\sum_as_a$. Consequently
$\operatorname{tr}\circ\eta=d\,\operatorname{id}_G$. Multiplication by
$d^{-1}\in\mathbf F_\ell$ defines
$r=d^{-1}\operatorname{tr}$ with $r\eta=\operatorname{id}_G$.
The stalk formulas are preserved by base change, so the direct-summand
decomposition and every filtration exact sequence are compatible with the
cohomology comparison maps.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.exists_finite_etale_cover_filtration
    {U : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace U] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] :
    ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ U) (_ : IsFinite v) (_ : Etale v) (_ : ConnectedSpace V)
      (d : ℕ), ¬ ℓ ∣ d ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U),
        Nat.card (v.GeometricFiber s) = d) ∧
      (∃ (n : ℕ)
        (W : ℕ → Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
        (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ W (i + 1)), IsZero (W 0) ∧
        Nonempty (W n ≅ (v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj G) ∧
        ∀ i < n, Mono (ι i) ∧ Nonempty (cokernel (ι i) ≅
          (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))))
